QUOTE: Each handler is a mixin function of the form `const XHandler = <TBase extends Constructor<ServerDataOperatorBase>>(superclass) => class extends superclass {...}`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says every handler write funnels through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`, via `ServerDataOperatorBase`, which extends `BaseDataOperator`. It also says each mixin is constrained to `Constructor<ServerDataOperatorBase>`. The one exception it names, a direct `database.write` call in `app/actions/websocket/reactions.ts`, is outside the handlers.
